dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp pixel intensity transitions from dark charcoal to cream-tan. The largest rings display scalloped, non-uniform perimeters with high-contrast boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Minimal occurrence of solid-pixel blobs. A high-intensity cluster without an internal gradient is localized at the posterior dorsal region, near the tail interface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent mid-dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse triangle. A linear chain of four smaller centroids is visible extending anteriorly along the upper lateral axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Accumulation of light-brown, granular texture on the tail/flipper area provides a localized contrast to the smooth, dark-toned pelage of the torso.
